columns.name: date
columns.description: Date of the entry (``YYYY-MM-DD``), local to the recording machine.

columns.name: time
columns.description: Time of the entry (``HH:MM:SS``), local to the recording machine.

columns.name: timezone
columns.description: Zone name and UTC offset at capture time, for human readers (e.g. ``CEST +02:00``). Parse ``acq_time`` instead.

columns.name: acq_time
columns.description: The entry's instant in ISO-8601 with its UTC offset (e.g. ``2026-06-26T16:46:14+02:00``). The machine-readable timestamp.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: Index of the stimulation block within a session. Every row of one block repeats its stimulation values.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Internal session counter, incremented each time the file is reopened for appending.

columns.name: is_initial
columns.description: ``1`` for the baseline block recorded before any configuration is tried; ``0`` for a recording block.

columns.name: scale_name
columns.description: Clinical or session scale name (or newline-separated names).

columns.name: scale_value
columns.description: Scale value, or ``n/a`` when the scale was not assessed at this block.

columns.name: electrode_model
columns.description: Implanted lead model, as named in ``schema/electrode_models.json``.

columns.name: program_id
columns.description: Stimulation program label (e.g., ``A``, ``B``).

columns.name: left_stim_freq
columns.description: Left stimulation frequency.

columns.name: left_anode
columns.description: Left anode contact(s) in the contact grammar: ``case`` for the can, ``E2`` for a ring, ``E2b`` for one segment, ``_`` joining several.

columns.name: left_cathode
columns.description: Left cathode contact(s), same grammar as ``left_anode``.

columns.name: left_amplitude
columns.description: Left amplitude. A single value, or per-contact values joined by ``_`` in ``left_cathode`` order when current is steered (``3.3_2.2`` is 5.5 mA split 60/40).

columns.name: left_pulse_width
columns.description: Left pulse width.

columns.name: right_stim_freq
columns.description: Right stimulation frequency.

columns.name: right_anode
columns.description: Right anode contact(s), same grammar as ``left_anode``.

columns.name: right_cathode
columns.description: Right cathode contact(s), same grammar as ``left_anode``.

columns.name: right_amplitude
columns.description: Right amplitude, same shape as ``left_amplitude``.

columns.name: right_pulse_width
columns.description: Right pulse width.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text note and side effects recorded at this block.
